card.name: First digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number that continues into more digits, such as postal codes, times, section numbers and edition numbers. It fires on that opening digit, not on later ones.

modes.label: Postal and ZIP codes
modes.description: First digit of a ZIP or postal code in an address or trial site listing.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: First digit of a section number in parentheses, such as 12.3 in a label.

modes.label: Times and other numbers
modes.description: First digit of a clock time, edition number or phone-style number.

card.writes: It favors tokens like minute and line/channel words, which fits numbers such as times and routes, but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up on the first digit of a number whose remaining digits are still to come, like a ZIP code or section number.
